name: Web
description: Reading web pages (web_fetch), RSS and Atom feeds (web_rss), and web search (web_search): Brave, Tavily, SearXNG or DuckDuckGo
settings.provider.title: Search engine
settings.provider.description: auto: the first one configured, Brave → Tavily → SearXNG; without any, the search goes through the browser. DuckDuckGo: its HTML page, which often turns automated requests away. Brave and Tavily keys are kept in the vault (brave_api_key, tavily_api_key, field value).
settings.searxngUrl.title: SearXNG address
settings.searxngUrl.description: For example, http://searxng:8080 (the json format must be enabled in the instance settings)
settings.allowPrivate.title: Allow local addresses
settings.allowPrivate.description: Let web_fetch reach local network addresses (10.x, 192.168.x, 127.x, etc.). Unsafe: enable only if you know why you need it.
settings.userAgent.title: User-Agent
settings.braveBaseUrl.title: Brave API address
settings.tavilyBaseUrl.title: Tavily API address
settings.duckduckgoUrl.title: DuckDuckGo HTML address
setup.brave.title: Brave Search API key
setup.brave.hint: Optional: better web search. Get a free key in the Brave Search API dashboard.
setup.tavily.title: Tavily API key
setup.tavily.hint: Optional: search tuned for agents. Get a key on app.tavily.com.
integration.summary: Web search, reading pages and RSS feeds; Brave or Tavily keys are optional, DuckDuckGo works without one
integration.example: What is new in the world today?
signal.rss_item.title: When a feed has a new item
